expect.title: One-Pan Harissa Chicken with Chickpeas
preparation: Mix the harissa, olive oil and cumin, and rub it all over the chicken thighs.
Spread the chickpeas, onion and tomatoes in a large roasting pan and season with salt and pepper.
Lay the chicken on top, skin side up, and roast for 45-50 minutes until the skin is crisp.
While it roasts, stir together all the salsa ingredients with a pinch of salt.
Spoon the salsa over the chicken just before serving.
tips: If the skin isn't crisp enough, slide the pan under the grill for the last 3 minutes.
You can swap the chickpeas for white beans.
excluded: This has been on repeat at our place since the clocks went back.
Everything goes in one pan, and the chickpeas soak up all the juices.
Save this one for a busy weeknight, and tag me if you make it!
